basic_info.description: 3BR/2BA single family home in Bernal Heights * A lovely center patio & multiple skylights give this midcentury home tremendous natural light* Formal living room w/ floor to ceiling windows & wood burning fireplace* Formal dining room w/ direct access to a sunny center patio * Remodeled chefs kitchen w/ quartz countertops & stainless steel appliances including a 4-burner gas range * 2 ample sized bedrooms & a remodeled bath w/ shower over tub complete the main level * The lower level was remodeled & expanded in 2018 with permits (and further remodeled in 2023) and includes a family room w/ wet bar, laundry room & primary bedroom w/ walk in closets & a spa-like en-suite bath * Direct access from the family room to the sunny west facing landscaped yard/patio is perfect for indoor/outdoor entertaining* Beautiful wood floors up and polished concrete floors down* Recessed lighting & double paned windows throughout* Solar panels & a sizable 1-car garage w/ office & workshop areas & excellent storage* Fantastic Bernal location. Walk to the shops & restaurants along Cortland. Close to the Alemany Farmers Market, public transportation & EZ freeway access
